description: Finalize a presigned upload batch after the client has PUT each file. Hosted calls return a background ingest jobId; poll it with ads_get_upload.

batchId.description: Upload batch ID returned by ads_upload with presigned=true.

files.description: Files returned by ads_upload presigned mode after the client has PUT each file to uploadUrl or each multipart chunk to parts[].url.

isThumbnail.description: True when this uploaded image is only a custom thumbnail and should not become standalone media.

partNumbers.description: Multipart part numbers returned by script mode. Finalization does not need signed URLs.

parts.description: Multipart part upload URLs returned by ads_upload. The finalize call does not need ETags.

thumbnailFileKey.description: For videos, staged fileKey of the custom thumbnail image to attach.

thumbnailFor.description: Video filename this thumbnail belongs to.

thumbnailForFileKey.description: For thumbnail images, the video fileKey this thumbnail belongs to.

thumbnailForName.description: For thumbnail images, the video filename this thumbnail belongs to.

uploadId.description: Multipart upload ID, present for files above the multipart threshold.

uploadUrl.description: Single-PUT upload URL, present for files at or below the multipart threshold.

thumbnailMap.description: Optional explicit video-to-thumbnail staged key map. ads_upload usually returns thumbnailFileKey on the video automatically.

name: ads_upload_finalize
title: Finalize Media Upload
